item.title: Peachtree Art Center
item.description: From painting and ceramics to fabric arts, Cricut-making and wood carving, there’s something to spark every imagination at Peachtree Art Center. Explore exhibitions featuring local and visiting artists, whose work is available for purchase. With programs for all ages and options for private events, creativity is always welcome here. Details: 2601 Sandy Plains Rd., peachtreeartcenter.com The post Peachtree Art Center first appeared on Atlanta Best Media.

item.title: Blackwell Farmers Market
item.description: Don’t miss the Blackwell Farmers Market at St. Andrew United Methodist Church, open one Saturday a month from April through August. Pick up fresh local produce, meats, cheeses, honey, plants and artisan products and grab lunch from the food trucks before you go home to unpack your finds. Details: 3455 Canton Rd. NE, instagram.com/blackwellfarmersmarket The post Blackwell Farmers Market first appeared on Atlanta Best Media.

item.title: Rock Steady Ballroom
item.description: Whether you’re preparing for the first dance at your wedding or just want to shine on the dance floor, Rock Steady Ballroom helps you strut your stuff. Skilled instructors teach adults of all levels a variety of classes from traditional ballroom to Latin and swing. Details: 15 Elan Ct., rocksteadyballroom.com The post Rock Steady Ballroom first appeared on Atlanta Best Media.

item.title: Ah-Beetz
item.description: You’ve had New York’s foldable slices. We love Chicago’s deep dish. But have you tried Connecticut’s pizza? Ah-Beetz is a friendly, casual date destination that serves authentic New Haven pizza: a thin, chewy, crisp crust cooked at super high temperatures. Try it and see how it compares to your usual pie! item.title: Sope Creek Trail
item.description: Ready to get outside? Take your date to Sope Creek Trail and hike 1.5 miles from the trailhead, past the 19th-century paper mill ruins (pro tip: it’s a great photo op!), over creeks and around to Sibley Pond. Finish the date with a picnic back at the trailhead. Details: 3760 Paper Mill Rd. SE, atlantatrails.com The post Sope Creek Trail first appeared on Atlanta Best Media.
